name: Text
label: String utilities
description: Replace, regex, split, join, case, trim, template, slug, strip_html. ReDoS timeout. strip_html is not a crawler.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Text operation. Set operation (or rely on config). Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'replace'.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Source text. Required for most ops.

schema.label: pattern
schema.description: Literal search string for operation replace; treated as regex when it contains regex metacharacters (not a lone '.'). With separator, splits on pattern and rejoins with separator.

schema.label: values
schema.description: Template variables for operation template. Example: {"name":"Ana"}.

schema.label: items
schema.description: Array to join for operation join (text alone is not enough). Example: ["a","b"].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Secrets redacted. File-producing ops also set `file` (type file). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: replace | regex | split | join | case | trim | template | slug | strip_html. Required. Example: 'replace'.

configurationParameters.label: Flags
configurationParameters.description: Regex flags: i, m, s. Example: 'i'.

configurationParameters.label: Values
configurationParameters.description: Template variables for operation template. Example: {"name":"Ana"}.

configurationParameters.label: Items
configurationParameters.description: Array to join for operation join (text alone is not enough). Example: ["a","b"].

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Keep at or below the sandbox request budget. Example: 25.
